map.输入流动资产与流动负债，求营运资金。: Compute net working capital from current assets and current liabilities for cash flow planning and liquidity management.
map.营运资金 = 流动资产 − 流动负债: Working capital = current assets − current liabilities
map.WC>0 通常表示短期偿债能力良好。: WC>0 usually means sound short-term solvency.
map.评估企业短期流动性余量，判断能否覆盖日常经营周转。: Assess a company's short-term liquidity buffer and whether it covers day-to-day operations.
map.扩张或接大单前，测算营运资金是否充足，避免资金链紧张。: Before expanding or taking a large order, check whether working capital is sufficient to avoid a cash squeeze.
map.监控营运资金随季节与账期波动，安排短期融资。: Track how working capital swings with seasons and payment terms so short-term financing can be arranged.
map.某公司流动资产 800 万元、流动负债 400 万元，营运资金=800−400=: A company has current assets of 800 (10k CNY) and current liabilities of 400 (10k CNY), so working capital = 800−400 = 400 (10k CNY) - the net funds freely available for day-to-day operations in the short term.
map.营运资金为正就一定安全吗？: Is positive working capital always safe?
map.正营运资金说明流动资产覆盖流动负债，但若大量是滞销存货或难收应收，实际流动性仍可: Positive working capital means current assets cover current liabilities, but if much of it is slow-moving inventory or hard-to-collect receivables, liquidity can still be tight, so look at quick assets as well.
map.营运资金为负怎么办？: What if working capital is negative?
map.负值意味着短期负债超过流动资产，依赖持续融资或加速回款维持；零售等强现金行业可短: A negative figure means current liabilities exceed current assets and operations rely on continued financing or faster collection; cash-rich industries such as retail can run negative for a while, but most companies need to improve their payment-term structure.
